data.name: Hyundai iLoad Refrigerated Long-Term Hire
data.description: Long-term refrigerated van hire across Melbourne. A white Hyundai iLoad fitted with a fridge unit, for food, catering, florists and any stock that has to stay cold.

mainEntity.name: How much does the refrigerated van cost to hire?

acceptedAnswer.text: The refrigerated Hyundai iLoad is $350 per week including GST, with 1,400 km included each week and a $500 bond.

mainEntity.name: What can I carry in it?

acceptedAnswer.text: It suits food, produce, catering, flowers and other stock that needs to stay cool. Tell us what you are moving when you enquire and we will confirm it is the right fit.
Yes, the refrigerated iLoad is an automatic and seats 3 including the driver.

mainEntity.name: Can I hire it long-term for my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It is built for long-term business hire on flexible weekly and monthly terms, with no long lock-in contract.
